name: GranTech Accessibility Audit
author: Marc Gran

sections.description:
GranTech Accessibility Audit scans your WordPress site for WCAG 2.2 compliance issues and generates the legally required Accessibility Statement in the format mandated by Spanish law (RD 1112/2018) and the European Accessibility Act (EAA, effective June 2025).

Key Features

  • WCAG 2.2 scanner — detects errors in images, headings, links, forms, colour contrast, and more.
  • Accessibility Statement generator — produces the required declaration in the official MINHAP format (Spain / RD 1112/2018).
  • Issue tracker — mark issues as in-progress, fixed, or not applicable, with justification.
  • History dashboard — track your accessibility score over time with a visual chart.
  • CSV export — export all issues for import into Jira, Trello, or Notion.
  • No overlays — unlike UserWay or AccessiBe, this plugin detects real problems instead of hiding them.

Who is this for?

  • Spanish public sector — websites and apps required to comply with RD 1112/2018.
  • NGOs and associations receiving public funding — also obligated by RD 1112/2018.
  • Private companies covered by Ley 11/2023 (Spain’s transposition of the EAA, in force since 28 June 2025): e-commerce, banking, transport, telecoms.
  • Companies offering goods/services to the public covered by Real Decreto 193/2023 on basic accessibility conditions and non-discrimination.
  • WordPress developers and agencies offering accessibility audit services to clients.
  • Any organisation that wants to demonstrate accessibility commitment without cost.

Technical notes

The free plan uses static HTML analysis (covers ~70% of WCAG 2.2 automated rules). The Pro plan adds JavaScript-rendered analysis for dynamic content. Both modes clearly document their limitations so you never get a false sense of compliance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the grantech-accessibility-audit folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Accessibility in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Run your first scan from the Scanner page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin guarantee legal compliance?

No. Automated scanners can detect approximately 30–40% of WCAG criteria. Full compliance requires a manual audit by an accessibility expert. The plugin documents this limitation clearly.

Is this an overlay like UserWay or AccessiBe?

No. This plugin analyses and reports real accessibility problems. It does not inject JavaScript to cosmetically hide issues. The Accessibility Statement it generates documents actual compliance status.

Which version of WCAG does it support?

WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA. This is the version referenced by EN 301 549 v3.2.1 and required by the European Accessibility Act.

Does this plugin send any data to external servers?

No. The scanner only fetches pages from your own website (the same domain WordPress is installed on) in order to analyse them. No data about you, your site, or your visitors is ever sent to GranTech or any third party. The plugin does not track usage and has no analytics. The only outbound links are documentation links (to w3.org) that open when you click them.

Where is the source code?

The full, unminified source code is included in the plugin itself. The PHP, JavaScript and CSS shipped in the download are the source — there is no build or compilation step, and no minified or obfuscated files. You can read and modify every file directly.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • 7 new automated UNE 153101 Easy-Read rules (readability index, double negations, serif fonts, background images, punctuation density, number formatting, tiny images) — manual checklist removed.
  • Compliance level now calculated automatically from the latest scan (score + open critical issues).
  • Site-wide scans: fixed missing score, duplicate scan records, and orphaned queued scans.
  • Rate limiting: only one scan can run at a time.
  • CSV export hardened against formula injection (RFC 4180).
  • Print/PDF mode for the Accessibility Statement.
  • Thumbnail URLs now resolve to the original attachment when fixing alt text.
  • Locale validation against installed language packs.
  • Detailed PDF report with full issue breakdown, score and legal framework.
  • 35 automated rules: WCAG 2.2 core + UNE-EN 301549 + UNE 153101 Easy-Read heuristics.
  • Guided fix assistant: applies content fixes directly and guides you to Settings for site-wide options (title, language).
